View Mode Switcher Toggle: 'Maand' vs 'Jaar' - data-testid='view-mode-month', data-testid='view-mode-year'
Year selector dropdown (visible in Year view or as context) - data-testid='year-select-dropdown'

tabs.label: Overzicht
tabs.content: Alert Banners + 4 KPI Cards + AI Insights + Quick Summary Grid

tabs.label: Grafieken & Categorieën
tabs.content: 3-Bar Recharts Chart (Inkomsten, Lasten, Doelen & Sparen) + Monthly Savings Area Chart + Category Donut breakdown with interactive dialog

tabs.label: Potjes & Doelen
tabs.content: Grid of Spaarpotjes cards showing budget vs spent/allocated this month, progress bar, pot balance, and quick deposit action

tabs.label: Per Persoon
tabs.content: Fair per-person split cards (Earns, Pays, Joint share, Keeps) with clear calculation breakdown formula

tabs.label: Maandtabel
tabs.content: 12-month Actual vs Forecast matrix table with active month highlighting, sticky columns, and quick filter

main_chart.features: Tooltip with exact Dutch formatting (€), Legend with click to filter series, ResponsiveContainer height 320px

category_donut.click_handler: Opens category detail dialog modal with transaction list

calculation_rules.pot_contributions: Sum of monthly target/deposit contributions to active Potjes

component_structure.Header.jsx: Sticky navigation with Month Stepper ('<', Month Name, '>'), Month/Year toggle, and quick settings
component_structure.Dashboard.jsx: Primary page component hosting Segmented Tabs (Overzicht, Grafieken, Potjes, Per Persoon, Maandtabel), KPI cards grid, and Floating Quick Add Button
component_structure.ControlCheckPanel.jsx: Audit & calculation inspector showing breakdown validation step-by-step
component_structure.AiAssistant.jsx: Compact smart card delivering contextual budgeting advice in Dutch

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep all language Dutch-first (e.g. 'Inkomsten', 'Vaste lasten', 'Variabele lasten', 'Overschot', 'Potjes', 'Spaarquote').
2. Place the month-switch arrows (< Current Month >) and the Maand/Jaar toggle button prominently in the top header/dashboard banner.
3. Restructure the dashboard with high-density Bento / Segmented Tabs so that the user does not have to scroll down a massive page. Everything is reachable within 1-2 clicks.
4. Ensure the main Recharts bar chart renders 3 distinct bars per month: Inkomsten (Emerald), Lasten (Rose), and Doelen & Sparen (Indigo).
5. Ensure calculations correctly sum Fixed + Variable expenses, deduct Pot allocations from Surplus to yield 'Netto na potjes', and update KPI values instantly on month change.
7. Do NOT break existing FastAPI backend contracts or endpoints.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Use precise typography, 1px crisp borders, dark/light theme awareness, clean spacing, and custom colors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react icons. NEVER use AI emojis like 🤖, 🧠, 💡 as icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_ids: Every interactive button, tab, card, or input MUST have data-testid in kebab-case.
